experiment: Evolutionary Prompt Optimization for LLM-Based Sentiment Analysis

best_evolved_prompt.prompt: Is the text positive or negative? Answer with exactly one word: positive or negative.

best_manual_prompt.name: Manual 3
best_manual_prompt.prompt: Look for praise, enthusiasm and approval (positive) versus complaints, disappointment and criticism (negative). Weigh the overall tone of the text, then output exactly one word: positive or negative.

verdict: Evolved prompt higher on validation by 0.70 points; statistically significant (McNemar p < 0.05).
limitations: Standard error of about 0.8 points on 1,000 examples.
Some crossover/mutation attempts returned a parent prompt after exhausting retries.
Diversity measures exact prompt-string uniqueness, not semantic diversity.
The final test set was not used.
